why: Drops the frame-count check, so two clips of different lengths are compared positionally and the surplus frames on the longer side are simply ignored. The issue rules this out by name: a comparison must not silently freeze, pad, truncate, or retime one side to conceal a mismatch, because the result looks exactly like a successful one.
killedBy: compareRefs: comparability of the two captures refuses two captures that differ in frame count, rather than scaling or padding
